text:
Cumulative future returns are nested: R(1:100) = R(1:10) + R(11:100). If the signal is related only to R(1:10), that covariance is still carried inside R(1:20), R(1:50), and R(1:100). Later independent noise may attenuate the correlation, but it does not mechanically erase the early contribution. This is why an early 5–10-session rebound can remain visible at 100.

If later non-overlapping blocks continue to earn conditional return beyond the unconditional and state-only baselines, a 100-session holding concept is potentially actionable. Actionability still depends on execution timing, drawdown, capital efficiency, turnover, and whether the rule meaningfully differs from always being long.
